checks.name: timeline has exactly one video and one audio clip per scene (no duplicates)
each voice clip starts `lead` s into its scene and ends inside it
silence between scenes <= 0.85 s (<= 1.5 s after scenes that hold a chart/summary)
no speech trimmed: every voice clip keeps >= 0.1 s after the last word
subtitles: inside scene, in order, no overlap, <= 56 chars
all cue-driven actions/appear times fall inside their scene
motion QA on all scenes (joint limits, no snaps/flips, arms never through torso)
